name: Valiant Communications Limited
about: Valiant Communications Limited manufactures and markets communications equipment. The company provides networking products, such as routers, ethernet failover/ab fallback switch, and industrial switches; power and utilities products; cybersecurity solutions and network isolation equipment; VCL Network-MouseTrapTM, a network security tool; data storage, TDM, and time and frequency synchronization products; EDFA and optical amplifier; and power converters, monitoring patch panels, splitters, converters, and other products. It serves power utilities, oil and gas, railways, airport communications, mobile backhaul, and corporate and defense sectors. Valiant Communications Limited has a strategic collaboration with Fortytwo42 Technology Innovations Private Limited. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.
